test_title: PYST 06: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A thief saw a policeman and he started running at a speed of 12 m/s. After a certain time, the policeman starts running behind the thief at a speed of 18 m/s. If the policeman covered a 540 m distance to catch the thief, the time (in seconds) after which the policeman started running is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the thief = 12 m/s

Speed of the policeman = 18 m/s

Distance covered by the policeman = 540 m

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Time taken to cover the 540 m by police is

T = 540/18 = 30 sec

Now in 30 sec total distance run by thief is,

DIstance × Time = 30 × 12 = 360 m

Now, remaining distance.

DRₑₘₐᵢₙᵢₙg = 540 - 360 = 180m

As remaining distance cover by the thief, when police was not running.

So, the time taken by thief to cover the remaining distance is,

T = 180/12 = 15 sec.

**The time after which the policeman started running is 15 seconds.**
